projects.name: CEM schema authoring
projects.description: Define a project-owned note schema and package, inspect and format native declarations, distinguish source validation from instance validation, and repair both contracts.

projects.name: CSS selector queries
projects.description: Validate explicit CSS-selector expressions, select native HTML and namespaced XML elements in document order, inspect original query bytes and repair malformed selector source.

projects.name: CSV inventory
projects.description: Inspect quoted spreadsheet cells and declared headers, diagnose and repair CSV source, and report low stock with native typed counts and HTML/JSON artifacts.

projects.name: HTML and CEM card

projects.name: JSON Schema source authoring
projects.description: Author Draft 2020-12 declarations with local definitions and reference syntax, format native schema source and repair an unsupported dialect without claiming instance validation.

projects.name: JSON and YAML report
projects.description: Inspect a JSON API payload and YAML configuration through retained native trees, filter service records and generate HTML, JSON and YAML reports with syntax failure and repair.

projects.name: Login
projects.description: Login sources, module and standalone queries, formatting, validation, native templates, a transformation graph with source provenance and an interactive light-DOM view.

projects.name: Markdown site
projects.description: Inspect and query an article, repair typed YAML metadata and preview its HTML, then build a portable folder-based Markdown + CEM-ML site with exact static assets and source provenance.

projects.name: MathML formula
projects.description: Inspect, validate, query and format a namespaced mathematical expression, repair its namespace and build a bounded Presentation MathML HTML preview.

projects.name: Module-map deployments
projects.description: Compare native v1/v2/v3 paired deployment maps, explicit resource copying and declared module-edge rewrites, with syntax/source controls, semantic planning refusals, native asset hashes and independent offline builds.

projects.name: Native DOM, AST and events
projects.description: Compare native source AST/event presentations, retained XML/plain-text inspection and explicit DOM/AST/event JSON or binary exports, with original ranges, shape repairs and clear import/ownership boundaries.

projects.name: Portable configurations
projects.description: Author native CLI command and run configurations, round-trip portable Studio manifests, and import/export a real project with relative resources, explicit build output and native ownership checks.

projects.name: RELAX NG source authoring
projects.description: Compare typed XML and compact schema source, inspect native lexical ranges, preserve formatting and repair start/delimiter/reference-policy errors without claiming instance validation.

projects.name: SCSS stylesheet
projects.description: Validate passive SCSS, inspect its expanded CSS, resolve a project-owned module, repair source syntax and build an independent HTML/CSS preview.

projects.name: Supplier pipeline
projects.description: Namespace-aware XML catalog validation and selection, then XML products and CSV stock reconciled through explicit native domain rules into JSON, YAML and HTML, with failure/repair and source provenance.

projects.name: SVG diagram
projects.description: Inspect, validate, query and format an accessible vector pipeline diagram, repair its namespace and build a bounded inline SVG HTML preview.

projects.name: XHTML document
projects.description: Inspect and validate XML-serialized HTML, query expanded names across XHTML and foreign SVG, repair a missing namespace and build a script-free HTML article.

projects.name: XPath catalog queries
projects.description: Parse, inspect and format typed XPath source; filter namespaced product data, join suppliers, inspect retained nodes and native map/array results, and repair saved query source.

projects.name: XSLT transformation
projects.description: Compare bounded native XSLT with CEM templates: validate and repair stylesheet source, transform owned XML directly, and build an explicit two-stage HTML report with native provenance.
